headline: Robust quarter, healthy visibility on growth pipeline

highlights: Hence, Q2FY27 revenue was up 12% QoQ with IGAAP EBITDA (cash EBIT) up 39% QoQ to INR 1bn at an IGAAP EBITDA margin of 22% (up 430bps QoQ) owing to higher VAS margins of 20%.
For the remainder of FY27, management is confident that growth momentum would sustain, with 1–1.5msf of new area becoming operational.
We build in a 26% revenue CAGR and 32% IGAAP EBITDA CAGR over FY26–28E.
We retain BUY with a revised TP of INR 271 (earlier INR 263) at 15x Sep’27E EV/EBITDA, as we raise our FY27–28E EBITDA by 2%, factoring in higher IGAAP EBITDA margin.
valuation: We retain BUY with a revised TP of INR 271 (earlier INR 263) at 15x Sep’27E EV/EBITDA, as we raise our FY27–28E EBITDA by 2%, factoring in higher IGAAP EBITDA margin.
